messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed best scores so a record changes only when a game finishes in fewer moves. Sizes without a record now show **Best: none**, including after a reload.

Verification passed: 140 unit tests, the build and typecheck, and all 77 browser tests. The changed files pass formatting; the repository-wide format check still reports issues in 13 untouched files.
